caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The chair features a high, elaborately carved backrest with a symmetrical design that incorporates curving lines and leafy motifs in shades of brown and tan. At the top of the backrest, there is a circular carved element framing a large stylized leaf. The seat and lower back sections of the chair contain an upholstered panel displaying a floral and vine pattern in green, yellow, and purple tones. The wooden frame of the chair is rendered with detailed cross-hatching and shading to suggest depth and dimension. The legs and the lower structure of the chair continue the curvilinear and carved aesthetic established in the backrest. In the lower right corner of the page, there is a handwritten signature in reddish-brown ink reading "Marcus N. Hansen."
title: Bootjack & Slipper-Holder
